proof_body:
by
  intro a d h
  have key : ∀ j : ℕ, a (2 * j + 1) = a 1 + (j : ℝ) * d ∧ a (2 * j + 2) = a 2 + (j : ℝ) * d := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j ih =>
      have h1 := h (2 * j + 1) (by omega)
      have h2 := h (2 * j + 2) (by omega)
      have e1 : 2 * (j + 1) + 1 = 2 * j + 1 + 2 := by ring
      have e2 : 2 * (j + 1) + 2 = 2 * j + 2 + 2 := by ring
      rw [e1, e2, h1, h2, ih.1, ih.2]
      push_cast
      constructor <;> ring
  intro m hm
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, m = j + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  have e1 : 2 * (j + 1) - 1 = 2 * j + 1 := by omega
  have e2 : 2 * (j + 1) = 2 * j + 2 := by ring
  rw [e1, e2, (key j).1, (key j).2]
  push_cast
  constructor <;> ring
